QUESTIONS

Before you DM.

How do I order?

Everything runs through DM. Message @urbanmiraaj on Instagram with the piece and size you want.

Where do you deliver?

Across Pakistan — delivery is nationwide.

What sizes are available?

It changes per drop — Capsule 01 ran Medium only. Every drop posts its own size chart, so check the chart before you DM.

Are the drops limited?

Yes. Wishes and Retro were both limited editions — when a drop sells out, it’s gone.

When will my order arrive?

Delivery timelines are confirmed in DM when you order.
